newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: INVICTA HITS NEW YR HIGH ON ROBUST RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: INVICTA HITS NEW YR HIGH ON ROBUST RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in Invicta Holdings Ltd, a South African agricultural machinery and automotive products firm, leapt to a new year high at the start of trading on Tuesday following the release of strong year results.
Invicta shares were up almost 13 percent or 65 cents, to a new 1997 high of 575 cents in early trade, but by 0814 GMT had slipped back to 550 cents, a gain of 40 cents.
"(The rise) is because of the results. It was much better than people expected," a dealer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.

Invicta earlier announced a jump in fully diluted earnings to 44.0 cents a share from 26.0 cents before. The dividend was increased to 15.0 cents from 10.0 cents a share, although directors said a capitalisation share award would be made.
